visual_action: Kamala Harris, wearing a dark blue suit and pearls, walks into view from the left side of a dark stage. She is smiling broadly and laughing as she waves to someone off-screen. As she moves to the right, an American flag becomes visible. She then warmly hugs an unidentified man in a suit.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the sole focus of the video, shown smiling, waving, and looking happy.

cast.name: unnamed man
cast.evidence: An unidentified man appears at the end of the video to hug Kamala Harris.

spoken_summary: The audio consists of song lyrics, including the prominent phrases "And I'm feeling... good" and "I'm feeling good." There is no other dialogue.
audio_music: An upbeat, soulful, and jazzy cover of the song "Feeling Good" plays throughout the entire video, creating a celebratory and confident atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous shot that follows Kamala Harris as she moves across the stage.
central_claim: Democrats are feeling happy, confident, and celebratory about the results of the November 8th election.
intended_effect: To make viewers, particularly supporters, share in a feeling of joy and confidence regarding the election.
